title: Chat response
description: The agent's turn in a chat transcript (`.interactive-item-container.interactive-response`): a full-width column of content parts (markdown, tool chains, question summaries), optionally headed by the collapsed "Completed N steps" disclosure with +added/-removed edit stats. Holds the CSS for all of its parts.
usage: After each <vsc-chat-request> inside a <vsc-chat-view>. Children are parts: <vsc-chat-markdown>, <vsc-chat-tool-chain>, <vsc-chat-question-summary>, <vsc-chat-question-carousel>. With summary, children in slot="steps" are the collapsed steps (shown when expanded); the final answer goes in the default slot.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Collapsed steps label, e.g. "Completed 5 steps in 48s"

attributes.name: added
attributes.description: Lines added, shown after the summary

attributes.name: removed
attributes.description: Lines removed, shown after the summary

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: Show the steps under the summary (toggled by clicking it)

slots.name: steps
slots.description: Parts hidden behind the summary disclosure

states.name: expanded
states.trigger: click the summary or set expanded

sources.note: captured from chat/chatRendering Wide, AutopilotCompletion, CompletedSummaryWithEdits

examples.html: <vsc-chat-response summary="Completed 5 steps in 48s" added="14" removed="3"><vsc-chat-tool-chain slot="steps"><vsc-chat-tool-call icon="book-compact">Read the renderer</vsc-chat-tool-call></vsc-chat-tool-chain><vsc-chat-markdown>The task is complete. The final response remains below the completed steps.</vsc-chat-markdown></vsc-chat-response>
